import pytest

from app.orders import OrderService


@pytest.fixture
def order_service():
    return OrderService()


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def order_payload():
    return {"id": "1", "topic": "order.created"}


def test_place_order(order_service, order_payload):
    order_service.place(order_payload)


def test_cancel_order(order_service):
    order_service.cancel("1")


def test_order_created_event(order_payload):
    assert order_payload["topic"] == "order.created"


def helper_not_a_test():
    pass
